# Sweet Escape

> Sweet Escape is a frozen-dessert shop at 1674 Whitten Rd, Suite 106, Memphis, Tennessee 38134, near Bartlett.

## Verified shop information

- Phone: +1-901-718-5812
- Regular hours: Monday-Thursday 12-9 PM; Friday-Sunday 12-10 PM
- Products listed by the shop include hand-dipped ice cream, self-serve frozen yogurt with toppings, gelato, sorbetto or sorbet, milkshakes, and cookie-based loaded treats.
